items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was he related to any of the other Jacksons? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Tuba played, played piano. Played trumpet, played piano.
Was he related to any of the other Jacksons?

items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: Only three men. Davy Jones, Floyd Jackson, Henry Sawyer. Only three men living in the band.

ctx.x: And he's playing what there? Baritone. Baritone.
Jackson. What's his first name? Floyd Jackson. He lived in Bridge City.
And Davy Jones you say was there and he's still alive too? Oh yeah he's living.

items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: Now this guy here... Floyd Jackson, bass player. ... David Jones, Floyd Jackson, Henry Sawyer.

ctx.x: Now this guy here, we used to call him Nug. He's got one hand, that's all I've been known. That's the only name. And he was a bass drum player. Bass drum player. John Porter's brother, he's Joe Porter. Cornet. Second, second cornet. Floyd Jackson, bass player. David Jones, I know you heard of him.
Oh yes, he's out in California.
